description: The chart is a horizontal grouped bar chart illustrating the difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimization steps. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Optimisations applied," listing the steps from top to bottom: "Normalised," "Add Spacing," "Remove Spacing," "Americanisms," and "Dates." The horizontal value axis is labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 0.001. The bars are grouped by the optimization step, with each group containing two horizontal bars representing different models, as indicated by a legend placed below the chart. The legend, titled "Model," assigns the color orange to the "NESAC ft model" and green to the "SESHA ft model." Within each category group, the orange bar is positioned above the green bar. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numeric annotation at its right end. For the "Normalised" category, the orange bar is 0.00334 (the longest orange bar) and the green bar is 0.00323. In the "Add Spacing" category, the orange bar is 0.00319 and the green bar is 0.00344 (the longest green bar). For "Remove Spacing," the values are 0.00311 for orange and 0.00306 for green. The "Americanisms" category shows 0.00299 for orange and 0.00302 for green. Finally, the "Dates" category contains the shortest bars for both models, with the orange bar at 0.00257 and the green bar at 0.00228. The categories on the vertical axis are not sorted alphabetically or by numerical value.
